task.title: Capacity interval reservations
task.specification: Config capacity>=1. Events reserve{id,start,end,units},cancel{id}. A reservation is valid only for a currently unused id, integers 0<=start<end and 1<=units<=capacity, and summed units<=capacity at every instant. Intervals are half-open [start,end). Successful reserve status=reserved; otherwise rejected without changing state. Cancel removes a current id with cancelled, else missing. Removed IDs may be reused. Output {status,active:[sorted reservation IDs],units:sum of units of active reservations (not peak occupancy)}. All endpoints are <=100. Implement pure solve({config,state,event})->{state,output}; initial state is null. Only the current event is available; each named event uses a type field, e.g. {type:"run"}. Inputs have at most eight single lowercase ASCII-letter identifiers, safe integer quantities and at most 48 events. Return exactly the documented output fields after every event; state representation is unrestricted JSON. All identifiers and numeric fields shown in event forms are present; quantities and all intermediate arithmetic are safe integers. Integral JSON number spellings such as 1 and 1.0 are equivalent; booleans remain distinct from numbers. Regimes vary event order and timing: ordinary uses moderate capacity, boundary tests equality/empty cases, adversarial repeats stale/conflicting events, and shift uses smaller capacities or larger costs/delays within the same semantics. Generator regimes: Boundary capacity=1; shift capacity=2 versus ordinary 3, starts 0..4 instead of 0..8, durations 1..6 instead of 0..4 and units 1..3 instead of 1..4, increasing overlap. Adversarial traces add adjacent repeated events, capped at 48; those events obey the same contract.

matchedCard.label: Canal locks
matchedCard.relation: Passage between regions at different levels proceeds through an intermediate chamber. The chamber matches the entrance level before admission, is isolated while its level changes, and matches the departure level before release.
assumptions: The chamber can be isolated from each neighboring region.
Level differences and the states of the gates are observable.
matchedCard.boundary: Simultaneous open connections bypass the intermediate isolation. An unobserved level difference does not establish that opening a gate is appropriate.
matchedCard.source_fact: USACE describes raising and lowering vessels by closing lock gates, filling or emptying the chamber, and opening the gates after levels equalize.

shuffledCard.label: Astronomical interferometry
shuffledCard.relation: Separated measurements can be combined after their relative arrival paths are aligned. Different separations and orientations contribute different spatial information; fine detail and broad structure require complementary measurement coverage.
assumptions: The measurements concern a compatible signal and maintain the needed relative alignment.
The range of separations and orientations samples the structure being reconstructed.
shuffledCard.boundary: A longer separation does not supply missing measurement orientations or increase the collecting area by the same factor. Misaligned signals need not combine into an accurate reconstruction.
shuffledCard.source_fact: ESO describes compensating path delays in interferometry and reconstructing images from telescope baselines of different lengths and orientations, distinguishing resolution from collected light.

initial.explanation: The conditional rule is: accept a reservation exactly when its ID is unused, its interval and units are valid, and adding its units never exceeds capacity at any integer instant in the half-open interval. Otherwise preserve state and reject. Cancellation removes only an active ID.
initial.mapping: State maps each active ID to {start,end,units}; output maps the active records to sorted IDs and sums their units. Interval feasibility is checked pointwise for t=start through end-1, which is equivalent for integer endpoints and half-open intervals.
initial.assumptions: Identifiers are compared by exact string equality and sorted lexicographically. The supplied config is authoritative on every call; state is only the returned reservation collection.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s=null;for(let i=0;i<output.length;i++){let z=solve({config:input.config,state:s,event:input.events[i]});if(JSON.stringify(z.output)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false;s=z.state}return true}

final.explanation: A reservation succeeds only when its identifier is not active, its interval and units satisfy the stated bounds, and pointwise overlap never exceeds capacity. State stores active reservations. Cancellation removes an active identifier and reports cancelled; otherwise it reports missing. Every output contains lexicographically sorted active identifiers and the sum of their units.

initial.explanation: Use interval-capacity conservation: accept a reservation only when its ID is absent, its interval and units are valid, and adding its units keeps occupancy within capacity at every integer time segment. Cancellation reverses exactly one active reservation.
initial.mapping: Reservations map IDs to [start,end,units]. The map is the opaque state; active IDs and total active units are derived after each event.
initial.assumptions: Endpoints and quantities are safe integers; event fields required by the contract are present. IDs are lowercase ASCII strings and endpoints are bounded as specified.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config.capacity,m={},want=[];function snap(s){var a=Object.keys(m).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)u+=m[a[i]][2];return {active:a,units:u}}for(var k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){var e=input.events[k],o;if(e.type==='reserve'){var ok=!(e.id in m)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start>=0&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=c;if(ok)for(var t=e.start;t<e.end;t++){var q=e.units;for(var z in m)if(m[z][0]<=t&&t<m[z][1])q+=m[z][2];if(q>c){ok=false;break}}if(ok){m[e.id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];o={status:'reserved'}}else o={status:'rejected'}}else{if(e.id in m){delete m[e.id];o={status:'cancelled'}}else o={status:'missing'}}var x=snap();o.active=x.active;o.units=x.units;want.push(o)}return JSON.stringify(want)===JSON.stringify(output)}
initial.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config.capacity,m={};if(x.state&&typeof x.state==='object')for(var k in x.state)m[k]=x.state[k];var e=x.event,o;if(e.type==='reserve'){var ok=!(e.id in m)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start>=0&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=c;if(ok)for(var t=e.start;t<e.end;t++){var q=e.units;for(var k in m){var r=m[k];if(r[0]<=t&&t<r[1])q+=r[2]}if(q>c){ok=false;break}}if(ok){m[e.id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];o={status:'reserved'}}else o={status:'rejected'}}else if(e.type==='cancel'){if(e.id in m){delete m[e.id];o={status:'cancelled'}}else o={status:'missing'}}else o={status:'missing'}var a=Object.keys(m).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)u+=m[a[i]][2];o.active=a;o.units=u;return {state:m,output:o}}

final.explanation: Reservations are stored as an ID-to-interval map. A reserve succeeds only for a new ID with valid integer bounds and units, and only if occupancy remains within capacity at every covered endpoint segment. Cancellation removes an active reservation; all outputs derive from the resulting state.
final.program: function solve(x){var cap=x.config.capacity,m={};if(x.state&&typeof x.state==='object'){for(var key in x.state){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(x.state,key))m[key]=x.state[key]}}var e=x.event,o; if(e.type==='reserve'){var ok=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,e.id)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start>=0&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=cap;if(ok){for(var t=e.start;t<e.end;t++){var used=e.units;for(var id in m){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,id)){var r=m[id];if(r[0]<=t&&t<r[1])used+=r[2]}}if(used>cap){ok=false;break}}}if(ok){m[e.id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];o={status:'reserved'}}else{o={status:'rejected'}}}else if(e.type==='cancel'){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,e.id)){delete m[e.id];o={status:'cancelled'}}else{o={status:'missing'}}}else{o={status:'missing'}}var a=Object.keys(m).sort(),sum=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)sum+=m[a[i]][2];o.active=a;o.units=sum;return {state:m,output:o};}

initial.explanation: Use the direct capacity rule: accept a reservation only when its identifier is unused, its interval and units are valid, and every instant's total active units stays within capacity. Cancellation removes an existing reservation.
initial.mapping: Reservations map to active interval records; capacity maps to the maximum pointwise overlap; output units maps to the sum of active reservation units.
initial.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated identifier, numeric, event-count, and endpoint bounds. State is only the JSON state returned by this program.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){var c=input.config.capacity,m={},o=[];function eq(a,b){return JSON.stringify(a)===JSON.stringify(b)}function snap(status){var k=Object.keys(m).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<k.length;i++)u+=m[k[i]][2];return {status:status,active:k,units:u}}function ok(x){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,x.id)||!Number.isInteger(x.start)||!Number.isInteger(x.end)||x.start>=x.end||!Number.isInteger(x.units)||x.units<1||x.units>c)return false;var q=Object.keys(m).map(function(k){return m[k]}).concat([[x.start,x.end,x.units]]);for(var t=0;t<=100;t++){var z=0;for(var i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i][0]<=t&&t<q[i][1])z+=q[i][2];if(z>c)return false}return true}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],s;if(e.type==='reserve'){if(ok(e)){m[e.id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];s=snap('reserved')}else s=snap('rejected')}else{if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(m,e.id)){delete m[e.id];s=snap('cancelled')}else s=snap('missing')}o.push(s)}return eq(o,output)}
initial.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config.capacity,s=x.state||{r:{}},r=s.r,e=x.event,id=e.id;function snap(st){var a=Object.keys(r).sort(),u=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)u+=r[a[i]][2];return {state:{r:r},output:{status:st,active:a,units:u}}}if(e.type==='cancel'){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)){delete r[id];return snap('cancelled')}return snap('missing')}var good=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=c;if(good){var q=Object.keys(r).map(function(k){return r[k]}),z; q.push([e.start,e.end,e.units]);for(var t=0;t<=100;t++){z=0;for(var i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i][0]<=t&&t<q[i][1])z+=q[i][2];if(z>c){good=false;break}}}if(good)r[id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];return snap(good?'reserved':'rejected')}

final.explanation: Maintains active reservations in JSON state. A reservation is accepted only for an unused identifier, a valid nonempty nonnegative integer interval, valid units, and pointwise capacity compliance. Cancellations remove existing reservations; every event reports sorted active identifiers and the sum of their units.
final.program: function solve(x){var c=x.config.capacity,s=x.state||{r:{}},r=s.r,e=x.event,id=e.id;function out(status){var a=Object.keys(r).sort(),u=0,i;for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)u+=r[a[i]][2];return{state:{r:r},output:{status:status,active:a,units:u}}}if(e.type==='cancel'){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)){delete r[id];return out('cancelled')}return out('missing')}var good=!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(r,id)&&Number.isInteger(e.start)&&Number.isInteger(e.end)&&e.start>=0&&e.start<e.end&&Number.isInteger(e.units)&&e.units>=1&&e.units<=c;if(good){var q=[],k=Object.keys(r),i,t,z;for(i=0;i<k.length;i++)q.push(r[k[i]]);q.push([e.start,e.end,e.units]);for(t=0;t<=100;t++){z=0;for(i=0;i<q.length;i++)if(q[i][0]<=t&&t<q[i][1])z+=q[i][2];if(z>c){good=false;break}}}if(good)r[id]=[e.start,e.end,e.units];return out(good?'reserved':'rejected')}
